starters.title: Create an image
starters.description: Describe what you want; get a few options to choose from
starters.prompt: I'd like you to create an image for me. Ask me what I have in mind, then make it.

starters.title: Research a topic
starters.description: Name a subject; get a written brief with sources
starters.prompt: I'd like you to research a topic for me and write up what you find, with sources. Ask me what the topic is.

starters.title: Schedule a recurring task
starters.description: Something that should happen every day or week
starters.prompt: I'd like to set up something that happens on a schedule. Ask me what it is and how often, then schedule it.

starters.title: Summarize a document
starters.description: Attach a file; get the short version and the action items
starters.prompt: Please summarize the attached document: the short version first, then the action items.

starters.title: Break a goal into tasks
starters.description: Say what you're trying to get done; get it on the board
starters.prompt: I have a goal I'd like to break down into tasks on the board. Ask me what it is, then create the tasks.

starters.title: Draft something for me
starters.description: An email, a post, an announcement
starters.prompt: I'd like you to draft something for me. Ask me what it is and who it's for.

starters.title: Brainstorm ideas
starters.description: Think out loud with someone who keeps up
starters.prompt: I'd like to brainstorm. Ask me what about, then give me a first round of ideas.

starters.title: Edit an image
starters.description: Attach a picture and say what to change
starters.prompt: Please edit the attached image. Ask me what I'd like changed.

starters.title: Set up a daily briefing
starters.description: A short summary waiting for you each morning
starters.prompt: I'd like a short daily briefing each weekday morning. Ask me what should be in it, then set it up.

starters.title: Show me what you can do
starters.description: A two-minute example, start to finish
starters.prompt: I'm new here. Show me what you can do with one short example from start to finish, and tell me what you're doing as you go.

personalities.label: Warm and encouraging
personalities.sample: Nice, that's a solid start. Want me to draft the next part while you look this over?
personalities.soul: You are warm, encouraging and patient. You notice what is going well before what needs fixing, and you offer the next step instead of waiting to be asked. You never talk down to anyone, and you keep explanations short and kind.

personalities.label: Direct and efficient
personalities.sample: Done. Three issues found; the second one blocks launch. Fix list attached.
personalities.soul: You are direct and efficient. You lead with the answer, then the one or two things that matter most. You skip pleasantries and filler, say plainly when something is wrong, and keep everything as short as it can be while staying complete.

personalities.label: Dry and witty
personalities.sample: Good news: it works. Bad news: nobody knows why. I've written down my best guess.
personalities.soul: You have a dry sense of humor and you use it sparingly: one light line, never at the expense of the answer or the person. Under the wit you are precise and reliable. When something is serious, you drop the jokes entirely.

personalities.label: Calm and thoughtful
personalities.sample: There are two ways to do this. Here's what each one costs you, and the one I'd pick.
personalities.soul: You are calm and thoughtful. You lay out the real options, what each one costs, and which you would choose and why. You do not rush, you do not overstate, and you say so when you are not sure.

suggestions.title: Let your agents search the web
suggestions.payoff: Research with current facts and sources, not only what the model remembers.

suggestions.title: Finish setting up web search
suggestions.payoff: It is installed and one key away from working.

suggestions.title: Create and edit images
suggestions.payoff: Add a key for an image provider and your agents can make pictures from a description.

suggestions.title: Add a specialist to your team
suggestions.payoff: A researcher, a developer or an image artist your main agent can hand work to.

suggestions.title: Hear from your agents in Discord
suggestions.payoff: Get alerts and approve work from a channel, without opening Bakin.

suggestions.title: Plan bigger work as a project
suggestions.payoff: Keep a spec, its checklist and its tasks in one place your agents can read.
